class.name: ResonanceDynamicGeometry
class.brief_description: Dynamic acoustic geometry for doors, moving platforms, and other animated objects.
class.description: Subclass of [ResonanceGeometry] with [member dynamic] fixed to true. Excluded from the baked static scene export. Export the mesh separately via Project -> Tools -> Nexus Resonance -> Export Dynamic Objects In Active Scene, or the inspector Export Mesh button when this node is selected. Assign a [ResonanceGeometryAsset] to [member mesh_asset] after export (auto-assigned by Export Dynamic Mesh). Enable path validation when movers can block baked paths: [member ResonanceRuntimeConfig.path_validation_enabled] on the runtime config, or [member ResonancePlayerConfig.path_validation_override] Enabled per source. Move the geometry node (or its rigid parent chain) as one body; animating only a child transform under the subtree is not supported, matching Steam Audio Dynamic Object rules. Inspector note: [member dynamic] is hidden. [member export_all_children] is hidden because dynamic subtrees are not merged this way.
